preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 1 and 5000, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 0 and 5000, inclusive.
The index of the capital is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of new roads that need to be built to make all the cities reachable from the capital, which is non-negative.
If the output is 0, then all cities are already reachable from the capital.

postconditions.expression: output > 0 implies not all_reachable(s) and exists_path(s, any_unreachable)
postconditions.description: If the output is greater than 0, then not all cities are reachable from the capital, and there exists at least one unreachable city.
